title: Two Shirts, Washed on the Sunday
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：worker　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 worker 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandfather was a ① worker at the yard for thirty-one years and owned two shirts, which my grandmother washed on the Sunday and which he wore until 1968, when she bought him five. He was a ② hard worker by everybody's account, and he said the phrase meant only that he had never learned how to stop.

His daughter, my mother, was an ③ office worker in the county town from 1961, and she had eleven blouses and wore three, and my grandmother said an office is a place where you are paid to be looked at, and a worker is judged by the shoes.

In 1987 a ④ care worker came three mornings a week, and my grandmother, who had refused help for thirty-one years, let her in on the second morning and never explained why. She kept bees, and she said the ⑤ worker bee does eleven days of work and then dies, which she said was not a tragedy but a system, and I have never been able to argue with it.

His ⑥ fellow workers at the yard, eleven of them, gave him a coat in 1974, and it was too big, and he wore it for twenty-four years, and it is the only present of his I still have, and no worker, he said, has ever owned his own coat. The ⑦ worker behind the counter at the labour exchange never looked up, and my father said that was the whole of 1974 in one picture.

The ⑧ worker, meaning a man of the trade and not of the office, was how he described the men who came after him, and he meant it as an insult and a compliment at the same time. The ⑨ worker he respected most was a woman who lasted eleven weeks at the yard in 1968 and was asked to leave, and he said she was better than any of them and that he had said nothing. The ⑩ worker I think about now, sixty years on, is not him: it is the woman who made the five shirts, on the Sunday, for thirty-one years, and whose name is on nothing.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （窗口、机关的）工作人员；职员
C. n. （某一行的）从业者；干这一行的人
D. n. 工蜂；职虫（worker bee）
E. 固定搭配：a hard worker 干活卖力的人；勤快人
F. 固定搭配：office worker 办公室职员；上班族
G. 固定搭配：care worker 护理员；照护工作者
H. 固定搭配：fellow workers 同事；工友

items.q: My grandfather was a worker at the yard
He was a hard worker by everybody's
was an office worker in the county town
a care worker came three mornings
the worker bee does eleven days
His fellow workers at the yard
The worker, meaning a man of the trade
The worker I think about now

answers.why: a worker 意为“工人、劳动者”，祖父在场院当了三十一年工人，只有两件衬衫。
a hard worker 意为“干活卖力的人、勤快人”，大家都说他干活卖力，而他说这无非表示他从没学会停下来。
an office worker 意为“办公室职员、上班族”，我母亲从 1961 年起在郡城做办公室职员。
a care worker 意为“护理员、照护工作者”，1987 年一位护理员每周来三个上午。
worker bee 意为“工蜂”，她说工蜂干十一天活就死去，那不是悲剧，而是一套系统。
fellow workers 意为“同事、工友”，场院的十一位工友在 1974 年送了他一件外套。
the worker behind the counter 意为“柜台后面的工作人员、职员”，劳工介绍所柜台后面那位工作人员始终没有抬头。
the worker ... of the trade 意为“这一行的从业者、干这一行的人”，他这样称呼后来接班的那些人。
the worker 意为“工人”，他最敬重的那位工人是 1968 年在场院干了十一周就被请走的一位女性。
the worker 意为“劳动者、干活的人”，如今我六十年后想到的那个劳动者不是他，而是三十一年里每周日做那五件衬衫的人。

她说工蜂干十一天活就死去，那不是悲剧，而是一套系统。（worker bee）
场院的十一位工友在 1974 年送了他一件外套，太大了，他穿了二十四年。（fellow workers）
answers: My grandfather was a worker at the yard for thirty-one years and owned two shirts, which my grandmother washed on the Sunday.
He was a hard worker by everybody's account, and he said it only meant he had never learned how to stop.
My mother was an office worker in the county town from 1961, with eleven blouses, of which she wore three.
In 1987 a care worker came three mornings a week, and my grandmother let her in on the second morning.
She said the worker bee does eleven days of work and then dies, and that it is a system and not a tragedy.
His fellow workers at the yard, eleven of them, gave him a coat in 1974; it was too big and he wore it for twenty-four years.
